prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1328; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's all right.
Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were sitting when the collision happened?
A: I was in the front passenger seat of my friend's sedan. We were stopped at a light on the main road in Sugar Land.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup behind us didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my body pushed forward, then back against the seat. My right hand hit the dashboard as we moved.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: No, I didn't hit my head. I stayed awake the whole time and I could talk to the other driver right after.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Yes, briefly. He apologized and said he had looked down at his phone for a second.
Q: Did police come to the scene?
A: Yes, an officer came and took information from everyone. I think he wrote the report down.
Q: When did you first notice pain in your wrist?
A: Almost right away, but I thought it was just a bruise. By that evening it was swelling badly and I could barely grip anything.
Q: Did you seek medical treatment, and what were you told?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They took X-rays and said the wrist was fractured. I was sent to a specialist and I've been in a splint since then.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, I've been off for a while because I write for a living and can't type comfortably with a splint on.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Only that I'm following my doctor's instructions and I want my medical bills taken care of. That's really all I have to add.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
